title: GraphQL Request
description: A minimal GraphQL client for sending queries and mutations.

data.text: graphql-request is a minimal GraphQL client that focuses on sending queries and mutations. It is lightweight, supports TypeScript, and works well with any GraphQL endpoint.

data.title: Installation
data.code:
npm install graphql-request graphql
# or
yarn add graphql-request graphql

data.title: Basic Query
data.content: Run a GraphQL query with graphql-request.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: It supports TypeScript out of the box
data.takeaway: Use graphql-request when you need a lightweight GraphQL client without the overhead of a full cache layer.
